name: Blueprint Drawing
summary: The product is drafted like a machine part; the metric that falls outside its tolerance band gets a coral revision cloud.
look: A teal blueprint sheet with minor/major grid, white 2.5 px hairlines, isometric exploded plates, dimension arrows and numbered balloons. Mono notes, serif titles and a title block on every frame; coral is reserved for out-of-tolerance.

components.name: Drafting grid
components.role: teal sheet with 30 px minor and 150 px major lines

components.name: Exploded view
components.role: dashboards or UI panels as isometric plates pulled apart

components.name: Dimension line
components.role: double-arrow measure for counts, ranges and the −18% drop

components.name: Callout balloon
components.role: numbered circle on a leader line linking part to note

components.name: Tolerance band + revision cloud
components.role: dashed normal range; coral scalloped cloud around the anomaly

components.name: Title block
components.role: checked by Pulse, approved by you, plus the action cell

motion.name: Line draw
motion.how: stroke-dashoffset 400–700 ms power1.inOut, layers staggered by an 8th note (250 ms at 120 BPM)

motion.name: Explode / assemble
motion.how: plates slide apart along the vertical axis, expo.out 900 ms, one per downbeat

motion.name: Dimension snap
motion.how: arrows grow from centre outward in 200 ms power3.out on the downbeat while the value counts up

story: Hook: an exploded stack of dashboards, each balloon noted UNREAD, dimensioned × 38, title block 'INSPECTED 3 / 38'. Reveal: construction lines and a width dimension draw around the Acme mark, balloon A points at the signal dot, 'Acme Pulse' writes on in serif. Proof: 'Out of tolerance.' — the checkout conversion line runs inside its band, dives below LOWER TOL after the 09:42 deploy #2231 marker, a −18% dimension and a revision cloud land, and the title block's ROLL BACK cell fills when the human approves. CTA: 'Every metric. Every minute.' over a release title block with a coral START FREE cell.
adapt: Draw your UI panels or architecture as exploded plates and your key metric as a measured line inside its normal range; put the human approval in the title block.

references.note: SVG stroke-drawing technique for line-draw motion

fit.risk: hairlines shimmer after compression; keep strokes ≥ 2 px and limit notes per sheet
